dependencies: Rust and Cargo 1.85 or newer for building; Cargo.lock pins libc 0.2.189
Unix host (macOS or Linux); this entry uses Unix process groups and atomic filesystem links
FFmpeg on PATH with fd protocol, the contract audio filters, pcm_s24le and libmp3lame
Destination filesystem supporting same-directory hardlinks and atomic rename
improvements: Atomic exclusive publication of the complete output inode avoids a full output copy and partial final visibility
Pinned validated input descriptors prevent pathname replacement from redirecting FFmpeg to a different file or FIFO
Atomically reserved sibling temporary; FFmpeg writes through an inherited seekable descriptor and finalizes WAV headers
Detects input/output inode aliases, including hardlinks and symlinks, and rechecks before publication; cleanup refuses changed temporary inodes
Signal handlers only record cancellation; one supervisor kills the owned group before reaping, avoiding stale-PID signal races
Bounded 16 KiB diagnostic tail and bounded pipe work; no reader thread or extra subprocess
Per-input decoded null outputs reject empty tracks; each encodes only one frame instead of the full track, with the primary DSP graph unchanged
Native CLI plus FFmpeg performs the DSP; no measured timing or memory superiority claim
